# Skrell
Skrell are amphibious humanoids from a cool, wet homeworld. Instead of hair they grow long, soft head-tails, which many decorate with jewelled headdresses. Their speech is a melodic mix of trills, warbles and croaks.
Skrell play the same as humans: they have no special strengths or weaknesses.
## Customisation - Head-tails in many lengths and styles, plus spots on the head and body. - Decorative headdresses, some in fixed metal colours and some you can recolour. - Optional tails and large Axiori eyes.
## Emotes - Skrell can [color=#1e90ff]peep[/color], [color=#1e90ff]warble[/color], [color=#1e90ff]trill[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]trill angrily[/color], each with its own sound.
